presentation.description:
Whenever you roll a natural 1 or 20 on an attack roll or saving throw during an encounter, you gain 1 luck token. Luck tokens remain until you spend them or until you take an extended rest, at which point you remove all unexpended luck tokens.

Whenever you make an attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check on your turn, you can expend one luck token after seeing the result. Roll a d6. On a result of 1–3, you gain a +1 bonus to the triggering roll. On a 4 or 5, you gain a +2 bonus to the triggering roll. On a 6, you can reroll the triggering roll and use the result you like. You have no limit to the number of luck tokens you can spend during an encounter, but you can spend only one token per turn.
presentation.title: Avandra's Luck

limitations: Authoring and printed rules only; runtime path effects and progression are unimplemented.

presentation.description: Avandra's favor turns chance itself into a resource you can bank and spend. Natural 1s and 20s earn luck tokens, and a token spent later nudges a roll upward or lets you try it again, while an action point can win you another token through a saving throw. Misfortune's Curse turns an enemy's missed blow into a gift for you, a lucky break can blunt a hit that would have hurt badly, and your daily attack leaves a foe dazed and slowed while you force its saves to be rerolled.

presentation.description:
You call to Avandra and ask the goddess to lift her gaze from your enemy. For a time, nothing goes right for your chosen foe.

DAILY / STANDARD

Ranged 10

Target: One creature

Attack: Highest ability vs. Will

Hit: 2d8 + highest ability psychic damage.

Effect: The target is dazed, slowed, takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls, and takes psychic damage equal to your highest ability the first time it misses with an attack on its turn (save ends all). Whenever the target succeeds on a saving throw to end the effect, you can spend 1 luck token as an immediate interrupt to force the target to reroll the saving throw and use the second result.

presentation.description:
Unexpected fortune turns a certain injury or even death into a close call.

DAILY / IMMEDIATE_INTERRUPT

Personal

Trigger: You take damage

Effect: Reduce the triggering damage by your healing surge value. You can spend 1 luck token to add 1d20 to this amount. If this reduces the damage to 0, you also shift 1 square.

presentation.description:
You steal a bit of luck from your enemy to leave the foe fumbling and stumbling through the fight.

ENCOUNTER / IMMEDIATE_REACTION

Melee touch

Trigger: An enemy adjacent to you misses you with a melee attack

Target: One creature

Effect: The triggering enemy repeats the attack against a legal target of your choice or itself, with a +2 bonus to the attack roll. If the attack hits and deals damage, it deals extra damage equal to your highest ability. In addition, if have 0 luck tokens when you use this power, you gain 1 luck token.
